title: Scalar faithfulness of the specified projective-line Chern adjunct
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring annihilated by $N$, $S$ a scheme, $h_P$ invertibility of $N$ on $P=\mathbf P^1_S$, and $c:\mathbf1_P\to A(1)_P[2]$ a representative of the actual Kummer class of $\mathcal O(1)$ [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. If the scalar orbit $a\mapsto H^2(U(a\,\mathrm{id}_{A(1)}))(\kappa)$ of this class is injective, then the specified Chern pushforward $\beta=\operatorname{ordinaryFiniteP1ChernPushforward}(c)$ is scalar faithful: $\beta\circ\operatorname{single}(a\,\mathrm{id}_{\mathbf1_S})=0$ implies $a=0$. The pushforward is the adjunct under the canonical ordinary derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction and the specified constant comparison [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows].

source.place: Geometric-fibre Kummer-class calculation and finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Linearity of inverse image and of the degree-zero single functors shows that the constant comparison commutes with scalar maps. If a scalar annihilates the adjunct, transpose this equality through the inverse-image/direct-image hom equivalence. Naturality identifies it with the comparison followed by the scalar multiple of c. Cancel the isomorphic constant comparison. The scalar then annihilates c, so scalar faithfulness of the specified class forces it to be zero. These are the Mathlib adjunction naturality and zero-map identities; the adjunction is the specified canonical derived adjunction, not an arbitrary orientation.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFiniteP1ChernPushforward_scalar_faithful
    (N : ℕ) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine S, ⊤)))
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S hP c)
    (hκ : Function.Injective (fun a : A ↦ Sheaf.H.map
      ((moduleAbelianForget A (ProjectiveLine S)).map
        (a • 𝟙 (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine (ProjectiveLine S) N A hA))) 2
      (ordinaryFiniteP1KummerClass A N hA S hP))) :
    ∀ a : A, (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        (a • 𝟙 (ordinaryFiniteConstant A S)) ≫
      ordinaryFiniteP1ChernPushforward A N hA S c = 0 → a = 0
